title: 第20章 偏差的因第21章 南无仙
lines: 二人连忙向前拜见
"参见四城主"
男子没有回应而是看向古一身后某处，下一刻他就出现在古一背后
古一后知后觉心中传来咚咚咚的心跳，越来越快，越来越快，突然一只手拍了他的背
"放轻松，别吓死了，我可不负责的"
古一刚才差点被活活吓死，本来精神紧绷，还没反应过来，男子就出现在他背后
今乙连忙过来输送了一些仙气入古一体内缓解
红发男子站在周岐的位置，闭上了双眼，然后过了很久他假装握住什么东西，向前一斩
血气迸发而出，直接将原本破碎的封仙域轰成废墟，两个老头也是一激灵
"他发生什么疯呢？"
"我怎么知道"
"我听得到"
红发男子睁开双眼，目光露出凝重之色
"非常强，这个人"
听着男子的话语二人也是一脸惊骇，平天城主，几乎都是站在整个道庭祖界的顶点了
这样的人都说非常强，不知为何会出现在封仙道界
"不过这个人强大的是他的意"
"意强？"
"嗯，大部分修士都是修为主，意为辅，这个人对意的理解很强，因为我一路而来，这道刀痕的确很夸张，但是没有很重的修为气息，全是鸿蒙紫气的残留"
"鸿蒙紫气！"看着两个老头一惊一乍男子也是无语
"鸿蒙紫气，我们肉身所修极境后可以动用的起源之息，我有预感会跟他见面的，而且…"
男子没有说完，他似乎觉得这道斩击有点熟悉的感觉，不仅是气息，更像是
"就这样吧，本尊便走了，后面散命洞天的人会来修补一下，至于修不修得好就难说了"男子刚打算离开，突然他望向某处
见他冲天而起向斩仙殿下方飞去，二人连忙追去
斩仙天宫化作一片废墟，但在某处石堆之中，有一个六七岁的小女孩昏迷在石堆里面，她的身上包裹着一层淡淡的光晕，安全的将她护住
男子望着女孩眼中闪过奇异之光，二人赶来也是目光一亮，刚打算上前
只见男子将女孩直接凌空包裹住
"这个小女孩有些特殊，适合我们平天城，我把她带走了"说罢化作红光遁去
二人无奈一笑
content_en:
The two of them hurried forward to pay their respects
"Meet the Four City Lords"
The man did not respond but looked somewhere behind Gu Yi. The next moment he appeared behind Gu Yi.
After realizing it, Gu Yi realized that his heartbeat was pounding in his heart, getting faster and faster, and suddenly a hand patted his back.
"Relax, don't be scared to death, I'm not responsible"
Gu Yi was almost scared to death just now. He was so nervous that before he could react, a man appeared behind him.
Jin Yi quickly came over and transported some immortal energy into Gu Yi's body to relieve the pain.
The red-haired man stood where Zhou Qi was and closed his eyes. After a long time, he pretended to hold something and slashed forward.
The blood energy burst out, directly blasting the originally shattered Immortal Realm into ruins. The two old men were also shocked.
"What's going on with him?"
"How do I know"
"I can hear it"
"…" "…"
The red-haired man opened his eyes, his eyes serious.
"Very strong, this person"
Listening to the man's words, the two of them also looked horrified. Pingtian City Lord was almost standing at the top of the entire Taoting Ancestral Realm.
People like this are said to be very powerful. I don’t know why they appear in the world of immortality.
"But what makes this person powerful is his will."
"Strong intention?"
"Well, most of the monks are mainly cultivation, with mind as a supplement. This person has a strong understanding of mind, because I came all the way. This knife mark is indeed exaggerated, but there is no heavy cultivation aura, it is all the residue of Hongmeng purple energy."
"Hongmeng Purple Qi!" Looking at the two old men, the man was also speechless.
"Hongmeng Purple Qi, the breath of origin that can be used after our physical body reaches the extreme state. I have a hunch that I will meet him, and..."
The man didn't finish speaking. He seemed to feel that this slash was a bit familiar, not just the breath, but more like
"That's it, I'm leaving. The people from Sanming Cave will come to repair it later. It's hard to say whether the repair is good or not." The man was about to leave, but suddenly he looked somewhere
"Eh"
Seeing him rising into the sky and flying towards the bottom of Zhanxian Hall, the two of them quickly chased after him.
Zhanxian Tian Palace was reduced to ruins, but somewhere in the pile of rocks, there was a little girl of six or seven years old unconscious in the pile of rocks. Her body was wrapped in a faint halo, protecting her safely.
The man looked at the girl with a strange light flashing in his eyes. When the two came over, their eyes lit up and they were about to step forward.
I saw the man wrapping the girl directly in the air
"This little girl is a bit special and suitable for our Pingtian City. I took her away." After saying that, she turned into red light and escaped.
The two of them smiled helplessly
